name: bench_threebody
description: Free base + two revolute-jointed links in series (base->arm1->arm2), no contact geometry. Verifies the RNEA backward-pass recursion propagates correctly across TWO joint levels, not just one.

joints.name: pivot1
joints.note: T1 rotation = Rx(-90 deg): joint axis (its local Z) = base's world Y axis at t=0.

joints.name: pivot2
joints.note: T1 rotation = identity: joint axis = arm1's own local Z axis, which (because of pivot1's Rx(-90)) is itself already world Y at t=0 -- so both joints share the same axis and the chain stays planar. T1 translation (0,0.5,0) = arm1's far end, 0.5 m along arm1's local +Y (its hang direction) from the pivot1 joint.

metadata.name: OpenMBD Benchmark - Three-Body Chain
metadata.description: Verification model: free base + 2 revolute links in series, no contact.
